narrative.overview:
Charcoal-navy grounds, ice-blue actions and original technical illustrations give this Hebrew learning platform a serious, cinematic character. Translucent slate belongs to course discovery; quieter opaque cards, fine dividers and readable rows support deeper learning content.

The finished gallery replaces the rejected Night Notebook identity, not the underlying learning tools. Course dashboards, module overviews, lesson readers and upcoming-course previews extend that identity through restrained learning interfaces. Marketing explicitly uses dark mode; learning screens preserve the user's light/dark preference.
keyCharacteristics: Dark tonal layering with selective ice-blue emphasis.
Self-hosted Heebo, Hebrew RTL and explicit LTR technical content.
Original local SVG course artwork, reused across gallery and catalog.
Clear live/coming-soon states and content-derived facts.

rules.name: The State Before Decoration Rule
rules.body: Use ice for actions, focus and selection; course illustrations may also carry luminous blue and pale highlights.

rules.name: The Language Direction Rule
rules.body: Keep Hebrew prose RTL; code, technology tag runs and the physical carousel track are explicitly LTR. Use tabular numerals for progress and counts.

rules.name: The Selection Owns Depth Rule
rules.body: Gallery previews rest at scale (.91), opacity (.76); the selected card becomes full scale and opacity and rises (-12px). Catalog hover rises (-4px) with an ice border, without inheriting gallery glass.

rules.name: The Continuous Gallery Rule
rules.body: A continuous position drives the track; modulo selection loops both ways. Recycle the twelve real cards offscreen, never duplicate tab IDs or rewind the full list at the boundary. Home/End select endpoints; both arrows remain enabled. Reduced motion centers instantly.

rules.name: The Learning Restraint Rule
rules.body: Use opaque theme-aware surfaces, ruled curriculum rows and compact ledgers. Keep a 272px desktop sidebar, keyboard-accessible dashboard tabs, a 72ch lesson article and a 184px TOC from 1280px. Smaller screens use a drawer and expandable lesson index. Preserve curriculum, quizzes, notes and progress storage.

dos: **Do** reuse shared dark tokens and the observed corner hierarchy.
**Do** keep original local course artwork consistent across gallery and catalog.
**Do** preserve keyboard selection, visible focus, RTL/LTR boundaries and reduced-motion behavior.
**Do** label upcoming content honestly and derive counts from real curriculum or local progress.
donts: **Don't** restore the rejected graph-paper notebook or handwritten display treatment.
**Don't** ban gradients, translucency or soft blue depth that the finished gallery uses.
**Don't** fabricate ratings, testimonials, enrollments or other proof.
**Don't** introduce external runtime image or font hosts.
